title: Phishing awareness
summary: Pause before acting on urgent or unexpected messages.
actions: Verify through a known channel; report suspicious messages.

title: Password security
summary: Use unique passwords and a password manager.
actions: Never reuse work credentials; enable MFA.

title: MFA
summary: MFA adds a verification step to sign-in.
actions: Deny unexpected prompts and report repeated requests.

title: Social engineering
summary: Attackers may use urgency, authority, or familiarity.
actions: Verify identity before sharing data or approving access.

title: Safe browsing
summary: Look carefully at destinations and unexpected downloads.
actions: Use approved bookmarks; do not open suspicious URLs.

title: Secure Wi-Fi
summary: Public networks can expose sensitive sessions.
actions: Use approved secure access and avoid sensitive work on unknown networks.

title: Software updates
actions: Install approved updates promptly and restart when required.

title: Ransomware awareness
summary: Unexpected encrypted files or extortion notes need rapid reporting.
actions: Disconnect per policy and contact the security team; do not investigate alone.

title: Removable media
summary: Unknown USB devices may introduce risk.
actions: Use only approved media and report found devices.

title: Data privacy
summary: Collect and share only information needed for the task.
actions: Use approved storage, access controls, and retention rules.

title: Mobile security
summary: Phones hold work accounts and sensitive data.
actions: Keep devices updated, locked, and report loss promptly.

title: Remote work
summary: Home environments still need secure habits.
actions: Lock screens, protect conversations, and use approved access methods.

title: Cloud account security
summary: Cloud sharing settings can expose data.
actions: Review recipients and permissions before sharing.

title: Incident reporting
actions: Report suspected incidents promptly, even if unsure.

title: AI-enabled scam awareness
summary: Generated messages and voices can imitate trusted people.
actions: Independently verify unusual requests using a known contact method.
